messages:
zoe (PM): Quick thread to lock a small, testable gating matrix for the long-term routing roadmap. Focus: micro-cutover for tenant isolation & affinity shim to satisfy a handful of early enterprise asks. Short comments please.

mike (Eng): I like smaller scoped pilots. What's the minimal infra change to support affinity shim?

zoe (PM): Proposal: implement an 'affinity shim' that can pin traffic to a tenant slice + a micro-cutover flow: sandbox -> internal pilot (1 tenant) -> 3% prod -> 25% -> full. Each step has timeboxed observation windows.

rahul (Arch): add a cold-start metric gate: when KV miss rate > 10% and model cold-start p95 increases > 1.5x baseline, block rollout. Also require model-variant fallback policy to be wired into the shim.

claire (SRE): ops constraints: before any prod canary we must have
- automated alerts for region.failover.init and tenant.p99.spike
- runbook for slice pinning and emergency evacuation
- smoke harness that runs top-30 prompts every 10m during canary
If smoke fails we rollback immediately.

ben (Sales): customers asking for 30s RTO on failover. can we promise it? they will push for it in negotiation.

mike (Eng): we can guarantee routing switch within 60s. full restoration (cache warm) may take several minutes depending on model size and dataset. propose contract wording: "automated routing switch within 60s; expected full performance restoration within 10 minutes under normal load".

rahul (Arch): routing policy idea: preflight constraints + affinity grace period. If tenant breaches p99 > 250ms for 5min, auto-move to isolated lane, but allow a 15-minute grace window to mitigate oscillation before marking as 'isolated' permanently.

claire (SRE): also require a chaos-check during staging: simulate a region egress failure and validate fallback route with one internal tenant first. record telemetry for time-to-route and error spike.

zoe (PM): draft launch signals (pass/fail):
- per-tenant p99 <= 180ms regional traffic (pass)
- combined error rate < 0.7%
- route-switch init < 60s
- KV cache hit ratio > 85% after 10 minutes for pinned tenants
- no quality regressions on customer top-5 prompts (embedding similarity threshold)
Thresholds can be tuned but want conservative defaults for pilot.

ben (Sales): Acme-lite pilot will accept those numbers if we include explicit rollback SLAs. I'll confirm exact language and post here.

mike (Eng): minimal implementation plan:
1) shim layer for affinity flags + routing override
2) expose canary hooks (traffic fraction + TTL) in runtime API
3) fallback variant registry (quantized/cheaper variants)
4) telemetry dashboard with per-tenant p50/p95/p99 + cache metrics
We can have a prototype in 3 sprints if scoped tightly.

rahul (Arch): acceptance checklist addition: automated regression harness comparing embeddings to baseline + human QA signoff on top-10 prompts before moving from 25% -> full.

claire (SRE): operational checklist add-on: ensure alerting has oncall routing + runbook links embedded; test runbook once during staging pilot.

zoe (PM): timeline suggestion: sprint 1 prototype routing shim + telemetry; sprint 2 internal pilot + chaos test; sprint 3 customer pilot (2 tenants) if internal pilot passes.

ben (Sales): Acme-lite asks for pilot within 6 weeks. I'll push to get NDA signed and confirm tenant list.

mike (Eng): we can accelerate if we limit model sizes for pilot and disable cross-region routing for initial pilot. less risk.

rahul (Arch): write a short policy doc: "affinity shim semantics, fallback precedence, migration/backoff windows". We'll version it and include test vectors.

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-9472: affinity-shim-micro-cutover. Owners: mike, claire, rahul, zoe. ETA: 2025-07-22.

zoe (PM): Action items: @mike - prototype PR for routing shim; @claire - runbook + chaos plan; @rahul - policy doc + acceptance checklist; @ben - confirm contract language with Acme-lite. I'll assemble gating matrix after initial PRs. Thanks!

mike (Eng): noted, will open PR this week.

claire (SRE): will draft runbook and schedule chaos run for staging.

ben (Sales): will post Acme's legal notes when I get them. :thumbsup:
